says: In today's tooling, the 0113 hold reads file names only, so three tracked '#!/bin/sh' scripts with no extension (bin/tsh, packages/pipeline/bin/tsh, packages/fabrika/bin/tsh-small) are neither listed nor marked edges, and a new extensionless shell script would pass; 0113 says no shell script enters the repo, though its own count was by extension.
proof: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 grep -l -m1 -E '^#!.*(sh|bash|python)' | grep -v -E '\.(sh|py)$' prints bin/tsh, packages/fabrika/bin/tsh-small and packages/pipeline/bin/tsh, each starting '#!/bin/sh'; node oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts exits 0 on that tree.
cost: Shell can keep entering the repo under a name without .sh, and the three launchers sit outside 0113's port list without a decision that they are edges.
